description: Four-channel VCA mixer whose four gains are stored in keyframes, the FRAME knob moving through the animation and interpolating between them

params.text: Sets the first channel's gain at the keyframe the FRAME knob is on, and does nothing between keyframes; in Poly LFO mode it sets the waveform of the four LFOs
Sets the second channel's gain at the keyframe the FRAME knob is on, and does nothing between keyframes; in Poly LFO mode it sets how much the waveform differs from one LFO to the next
Sets the third channel's gain at the keyframe the FRAME knob is on, and does nothing between keyframes; in Poly LFO mode it sets how far apart in frequency the four LFOs run
Sets the fourth channel's gain at the keyframe the FRAME knob is on, and does nothing between keyframes; in Poly LFO mode it sets how strongly the four LFOs pull each other into step
Stores a keyframe at the current position of the FRAME knob, holding the four gains as they stand
Removes the keyframe at the current position of the FRAME knob
Moves through the animation from its start to its end, the four gains following as it goes; in Poly LFO mode it sets the rate of the LFOs
Attenuverts the FRAME input, setting how far and in which direction a voltage moves the animation
Sends a constant 10V into the ALL input when nothing is patched there, which turns the four channels into CV sources

inputs.text: Feeds every channel whose own input is unpatched
The signal for that channel; with nothing patched it takes the ALL input
Moves through the animation through the MODULATION attenuverter, 10V covering the whole animation at full

outputs.text: The sum of the channels whose own outputs are unpatched, halved and clipped at 10V
That channel after its VCA, and patching it takes that channel out of the MIX output
Nothing in the module writes to this output; it stays at 0V however the animation moves

notes: a new Frames holds no keyframes, and until one is stored the four gain knobs set their channel gains directly and the FRAME knob does not move them.
the add button stores a keyframe at the FRAME knob's position, holding the four gains as they stand.
the four gain knobs come up at zero, so nothing reaches the outputs until one of them is raised.
the module is monophonic: on a polyphonic cable only the first channel is read.
menu: Channel 1, Channel 2, Channel 3 and Channel 4 — each carries the Interpolation curve and Response curve settings for that channel
Interpolation curve, inside a channel's submenu — how that channel's gain travels between keyframes: Step, Linear, Accelerating, Decelerating, Departure/arrival or Bouncing
Response curve, inside a channel's submenu — sets that channel's VCA to Linear or Exponential
Clear keyframes — empties the animation and leaves the four knobs in direct control of the gains
Keyframer and Poly LFO — the two entries under Alternate modes, Poly LFO replacing the keyframer with four linked LFOs whose levels drive the four VCAs
